column3: Gives an agent the capability to author, validate, and deliver interactive architecture/workflow/sequence/dataflow/lifecycle diagrams via this repo's bundled Node CLI (product-bound); the same skill is also distributed as the byte-identical archive archify.zip, a duplicate of this shorter path.
Gives an agent a value/cost/impact framework for triaging Archify issues, PRs, and code changes; standalone, since it is a reasoning framework that does not itself require running the archify CLI.

Configures the third-party CodeRabbit review agent's tone, path-specific review instructions, and merge-gate checks for this repository's pull requests; standalone, since it does not itself execute the archify CLI.
